surface_verification.justification: test-only AC-binding backfill (FR-01.08/FR-01.09); no startable web/dev-server/CLI surface of its own to browser-verify -- verification is the unit/integration test suite itself (F0), plus the four ADR-044 roots this unit touched run individually with their own --junitxml.

behaviors.behavior: FR-01.08/AC01: a release actually reaches the target and is made to run there, and more than one hosting kind can be configured
FR-01.08/AC03-AC04: a completed release is contacted to prove it is alive, polled per the target's own deadline

FR-01.08/AC06-AC07,AC13-AC14: rollback confirms/mismatches/downgrades the readback claim; drifted data refuses and names the strategy; a failed way-back halts and is distinguished from a pre-contact refusal
FR-01.08/AC09: every offered target's rollback discipline is checked against one common schema, including a target with a missing rollback block being rejected
FR-01.08/AC10,AC15: a stop-only clone rollback is reported as stopping not restoring; a completed rollback leaves stored data alone and the target's own strategy answers what happens to it
FR-01.08/AC02,AC05,AC08,AC11,AC12: agent-orchestrated SKILL.md steps with no coded gate/trigger to exercise
behaviors.reason: test-gate confirmation, auto-rollback-on-smoke-failure, override-record, cause-recording and manual-confirm+liveness-proof are all agent AskUserQuestion/decision-log prose in SKILL.md -- an interactive step the test harness cannot drive, not a coded runtime path; filed as trg-7a6a9562 for AC02/AC05 specifically

behaviors.behavior: FR-01.09/AC02,AC04: commits are categorized by kind; the version-bump rule (incl. the pre-1.0 breaking exception) is followed exactly

FR-01.09/AC03,AC06-AC10: no pending work reports an empty section not an empty release; a new release lands above the prior one; a rerun replaces rather than duplicates or is refused with a named reason; legacy bullets are preserved and warned; dry-run previews without writing
FR-01.09/AC05: two decision records from independent drops get sequential ADR numbers assigned at one aggregation point
FR-01.09/AC11: preparing a release publishes nothing by itself -- no git/gh process-launch call happens during aggregation
FR-01.09/AC12-AC13: a manifest write is checked against the committed blob afterward; a manifest carrying its version in more than one place gets every occurrence written together
FR-01.09/AC14: the release page is checked against a fixed expected shape and actually created, carrying the summary and link
FR-01.09/AC01,AC15: conjunctive claims whose second clause (a version tag + PR; a retroactive-non-creation guarantee) has no code artifact to invoke
behaviors.reason: AC01's tag+PR steps are raw `git tag`/`gh pr create` shell commands the agent runs interactively in SKILL.md, not a single deterministic seam a test harness can invoke; AC15's second clause is a property of how SKILL.md sequences those same interactive calls (once, per newly-tagged version), not something create_github_release.py/publish_release_notes.py can distinguish at the code level
